operations.description: List all commerce customers for the given company and data connection
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list customers [PATH] companies connections data commerce customers [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] customer customers
[METHOD] get [NAME] list disputes [PATH] companies connections data commerce disputes [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] dispute disputes

operations.description:
Retrieve information about the company, as seen in the commerce platform.

This may include information like addresses, tax registration details and social media or website information.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] company info [PATH] companies connections data commerce info [PARAMS] company connection id [SCHEMA] account address balance company created currency date dates info modified number phone time

operations.description:
Retrieve a list of locations as seen in the commerce platform.

A `location` is a geographic place at which stocks of products may be held, or from where orders were placed.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list locations [PATH] companies connections data commerce locations [PARAMS] company connection id [SCHEMA] locations response

operations.description: Get a list of orders placed or held on the linked commerce platform
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list orders [PATH] companies connections data commerce orders [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] order orders

operations.description: Retrieve a list of payment methods, such as card, cash or other online payment methods, as held in the linked commerce platform.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list payment methods [PATH] companies connections data commerce payment methods [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] method methods payment

operations.description: List commerce payments for the given company & data connection.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list payments [PATH] companies connections data commerce payments [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] payment payments

operations.description: Product categories are used to classify a group of products together, either by type (eg "Furniture"), or sometimes by tax profile.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list product categories [PATH] companies connections data commerce product categories [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] categories category product

operations.description: The Products data type provides the company's product inventory, and includes the price and quantity of all products, and product variants, available for sale.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list products [PATH] companies connections data commerce products [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] product products

operations.description: This endpoint returns a lits of tax rates from the commerce platform, including tax rate names and values. This supports the mapping of tax rates from the commerce platform to the accounting platform.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] tax components [PATH] companies connections data commerce tax components [PARAMS] company connection id [SCHEMA] 0 component components dates modified tax

operations.description: Details of all financial transactions recorded in the commerce or point of sale system are added to the Transactions data type. For example, payments, service charges, and fees.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list transactions [PATH] companies connections data commerce transactions [PARAMS] by company connection id order page query size [SCHEMA] transaction transactions
